### workspaceBuildStepSchema

```ts
const workspaceBuildStepSchema: Union<
  readonly [
    Struct<{
      kind: Literal<"typescript">;
      config: String;
    }>,
    Struct<{
      kind: Literal<"tailwind">;
      input: String;
      output: String;
    }>,
    Struct<{
      kind: Literal<"script">;
      directory: String;
      script: String;
    }>,
  ]
>;
```

One captured dependency build step. Paths are relative to the captured snapshot
root. A TypeScript step compiles one config; a Tailwind step compiles one
stylesheet input into its output (the same path for an App's own stylesheet,
which compiles in place). A script step runs the one `package.json` script a
workspace dependency names as its build (`fungi.build.script`), with pnpm, in
that package's directory; only an admitted Computer build executes it.

### bundledHtmlRecipe

```ts
const bundledHtmlRecipe: Readonly<{
  kind: "bundled-html";
  toolchain: Readonly<{
    recipe: "captured-bundled-html-v1";
  }>;
  limits: Readonly<{

  }>;
```

Engine/toolchain-independent input: an already bundled, captured directory. The
producer owns compilation; Publisher never discovers its build scripts. These
ceilings cannot be raised by a publication request.

---

### workspaceBuildPolicySchema

```ts
const workspaceBuildPolicySchema: Struct<{
  kind: optional<Literals<readonly ["bundled-html", "source-html"]>>;
  assets: optional<
    Struct<{
      maxManifestBytes: Number;
      maxObjects: Number;
      maxObjectBytes: Number;
      maxTotalBytes: Number;
    }>
  >;
  assetBase: optionalKey<String>;
  entry: optional<String>;
  backend: optional<
    Union<
      readonly [
        Null,
        Struct<{
          entry: optional<String>;
          runtime: Struct<{
            kind: Literal<"durable-facet">;
            stateSchema: Number;
          }>;
          compatibilityDate: String;
          exportName: String;
        }>,
      ]
    >
  >;
  maxOutputBytes: optional<Number>;
  react: optional<Boolean>;
  shellEntry: optional<String>;
  packageStylesheets: optional<$Array<String>>;
  stylesheets: optional<$Array<String>>;
  typescript: optional<$Array<String>>;
  script: optional<NonEmptyString>;
  stylesheet: optional<
    Struct<{
      input: String;
      output: String;
    }>
  >;
}>;
```

`package.json#fungi.build`. An App manifest (the manifest nearest the entry)
declares its recipe beside the page policy: `react`, `shellEntry`, the workspace
packages whose declared stylesheets compile first (`packageStylesheets`) and its
own `stylesheets`, compiled in place, in order. A workspace package declares its
build products: extra TypeScript configs compiled after its
`tsconfig.build.json`, and its stylesheet input and output; or, instead of
TypeScript configs, the one `package.json` script that builds it (`script`),
which only an admitted Computer build runs. Every path is relative to the
manifest that declares it. Dependency-only metadata needs no App recipe; App
callers require one through appBuildRecipe. Unknown fields are refused, so a
builder never silently ignores a policy it does not know.

### createDefinitionEmission()

```ts
function createDefinitionEmission(source, recipe): Promise<{
  entryPoints: (entry) => Record<string, string>;
  outdir: string;
  plugins: Plugin[];
  worker: AppBackendOutput;
  declare: Promise<Readonly<{
     api?: Readonly<{
        methods: Readonly<Record<string, Readonly<...>>>;
        toolFamily?: Readonly<{
           name: ...;
           list: ...;
           call: ...;
        }>;
        events?: Readonly<Record<..., ...>>;
     }>;
     displayName?: string;
     capabilities: readonly (
        | "computer.list"
        | "computer.readFile"
        | "computer.writeFile"
        | "computer.execute"
        | "approvals"
        | "agent.list"
        | "agent.manage"
        | "agent.rename"
        | "agent.avatar"
        | "agent.toolPolicy"
        | "agent.read"
        | "agent.send"
        | "llm.generation"
        | "media.generation"
        | "games:servers"
        | "git.repository"
        | "apps.open"
        | "apps.call"
        | "app.storage"
        | "app.events.emit"
        | "team.workbenchHost"
        | "marketplace.browse"
        | "marketplace.purchase"
        | "workflow.run"
        | "workflow.publish"
        | "workflow.arm"
        | "world"
        | "channels.read"
       | "channels.personal.manage")[];
     calls?: readonly Readonly<{
        appId: string;
        methods: readonly string[];
     }>[];
     guidance?: string;
     handlers: readonly "file.open"[];
     receives?: readonly "git.push"[];
     icon?: string;
     roles: readonly ("files" | "dashboard" | "inbox" | "media" | "sessions" | "terminal")[];
     storage?: readonly Readonly<{
        key: string;
        scopes: readonly (... | ...)[];
        maxBytes: number;
     }>[];
     commands?: readonly Readonly<{
        id: string;
        title: string;
        category: string;
        description?: string;
        sigil?: string;
        projections?: Readonly<...>;
     }>[];
     gills?: readonly Readonly<{
        id: string;
        source: string;
        title: string;
        params?: readonly ...[];
        watch?: AppGillWatch;
        desktop?: Readonly<...>;
     }>[];
     backend?: Readonly<{
        bindings: readonly Readonly<{
           name: ...;
           operations: ...;
        }>[];
        sync?: Readonly<{
           method: ...;
        }>;
     }>;
  }>>;
}>;
```

Build one App backend and derive its declaration from that same build.

A declared `fungi.backendDefinition` adds a second, build-only entry that
derives the declaration with `buildAppDeclaration(appBackend, fungi.app)`.
esbuild loads every path and resolves every import once per build, so the Worker
serves exactly the definition bytes and module resolution the declaration
describes. The Worker output is then checked to include that definition and no
build-only declaration code, and the declaration output to import nothing at
runtime.

```ts
    appId: AppId;
```

`unknown`\>

### resolveWorkspaceBuild()

```ts
function resolveWorkspaceBuild(options): Promise<
  Readonly<{
    directory: string;
    packageName: string;
    react: boolean;
    shellEntry?: string;
    dependencies: readonly string[];
    steps: readonly (
      | {
          kind: "typescript";
          config: string;
        }
      | {
          kind: "tailwind";
          input: string;
          output: string;
        }
      | {
          kind: "script";
          directory: string;
          script: string;
        }
    )[];
  }>
>;
```

Derive one App's page build from the captured source alone: the manifest nearest
`entry` must be the owning pnpm workspace (or standalone repository root). It
declares the App policy, its runtime imports select its compile roots; their
`workspace:` dependencies give the compile order, and each dependency's manifest
declares its own extra build products.

#### Parameters

| Parameter               | Type                                                                                                  | Description                                                            |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `options`               | \{ `root`: `string`; `entry`: `string`; `backendEntry?`: `string` \| `null`; `projects`: `string`; \} | -                                                                      |
| `options.root`          | `string`                                                                                              | -                                                                      |
| `options.entry`         | `string`                                                                                              | -                                                                      |
| `options.backendEntry?` | `string` \| `null`                                                                                    | The selected recipe's backend, if it differs from the manifest recipe. |
| `options.projects`      | `string`                                                                                              | `pnpm ls -r --depth -1 --json` output for the same source tree.        |

#### Returns

`Promise`\<`Readonly`\<\{ `directory`: `string`; `packageName`: `string`;
`react`: `boolean`; `shellEntry?`: `string`; `dependencies`: readonly
`string`[]; `steps`: readonly ( \| \{ `kind`: `"typescript"`; `config`:
`string`; \} \| \{ `kind`: `"tailwind"`; `input`: `string`; `output`: `string`;
\} \| \{ `kind`: `"script"`; `directory`: `string`; `script`: `string`; \})[];
\}\>\>
